2153:7838.name: Text Content Title
2153:7838.after: Code: TextContentTitle from "primitives" (props: title, subtitle, align). Use once per page as the page heading; it renders the page-level title and subtitle.

2087:8488.name: Text Heading
2087:8488.after: Code: TextHeading from "primitives". Use for section headings inside a page (or TextContentHeading with heading/subheading props).

124:8256.name: Notification
124:8256.before: Keywords: message, alert, feedback, callout, banner
124:8256.after:
Code: Notification from "primitives" (props: variant "alert" | "message", icon, isDismissible; children = content). Use variant="alert" for errors that block an action and variant="message" for confirmations.

Keywords: message, alert, feedback, callout, banner

2136:2263.name: Input Field
2136:2263.after: Code: InputField from "primitives" (props: label, description, errorMessage, isInvalid, isDisabled, type, value, onChange). Help text goes in description. Show validation errors with isInvalid + errorMessage; do not render custom error text.

9762:1902.name: Switch Field
9762:1902.after:
Code: SwitchField from "primitives" (props: label, description, isSelected, onChange, isDisabled). Use for on/off preferences; wrap several in SwitchGroup. A setting that cannot be changed is isDisabled.

Keywords: toggle

2010:15581.name: Avatar Block
2010:15581.after: Code: AvatarBlock from "primitives" (props: title, description; children = <Avatar initials="A" /> or <Avatar src=... />). Use to show a person with name and secondary text such as email.

2136:2336.name: Select Field
2136:2336.after:
Code: SelectField + SelectItem from "primitives" (props: label or aria-label, selectedKey, onSelectionChange, isDisabled; SelectItem id + children). Use for choosing one option from a short list, e.g. a role.

Keywords: dropdown

185:852.name: Button Danger
185:852.after:
Code: ButtonDanger from "primitives" (variant "danger-primary" | "danger-subtle", size, isDisabled). Use for destructive actions such as removing a member or deleting data. The regular Button component does not accept danger variants.

Keywords: action, negative, destructive

2072:9432.name: Button Group
2072:9432.after:
Code: ButtonGroup from "primitives" (align "start" | "end" | "center" | "justify" | "stack"). Wrap related actions such as Cancel + Save.

Keywords: actions

4185:3778.name: Button
4185:3778.after: Code: Button from "primitives" (variant "primary" | "neutral" | "subtle", size "medium" | "small", isDisabled, onPress). One primary action per view; use neutral for Cancel. Destructive actions use Button Danger instead.
